description:
Observable infrastructure that lets fiber-based components subscribe to live GenServer processes and receive reactive updates.

Tracks B and C are prerequisites. Track B must be fully merged before starting this track. C1 (hook slot infrastructure) must be complete before D4 (use_observable hook).

Track D delivers five focused tickets:
  D1 — Filament.Observable behaviour (callbacks + public subscribe/unsubscribe API)
  D2 — Filament.Observable.GenServer macro (subscriber tracking, monitors, notify_observers/1)
  D3 — Projection support + change-or-bust (per-subscriber project fn, skip unchanged)
  D4 — use_observable/3 hook (subscribe on mount, return projected value, handle_info update path)
  D5 — Backpressure (detect saturated mailbox, drop + signal resubscribe on next render)

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html § Track D
title: Track D: Domain state subscriptions — Observable behaviour, GenServer macro, use_observable hook
